aboutGame.title: What is Build a Dino Defense?
paragraphs: Build a Dino Defense is an action-packed cooperative strategy and tower defense experience on Roblox developed by Big Chomp Games. Players team up in servers of up to 6 to construct impenetrable fortifications, lay tactical traps, install automated turrets, and battle relentless waves of ravenous dinosaurs to protect their precious egg.

Whether you are placing your first wooden barricade, cracking open high-tier weapon crates to blast raptors, or mastering complex maze layouts against giant dinosaur bosses, our wiki covers every system with verified stats, tier rankings, and battle-tested strategies.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Build a Dino Defense.

items.question: What is Build a Dino Defense on Roblox?
items.answer: Build a Dino Defense is a multiplayer strategy tower defense game on Roblox by Big Chomp Games where up to 6 players build fortified bases, lay traps, deploy turrets, and fend off hungry dinosaur waves to protect their egg.

items.question: How do you play Build a Dino Defense and protect the egg?
items.answer: In Build a Dino Defense, players spend cash earned from defeating dinosaurs to construct perimeter walls, position automated turrets, place ground traps, and use personal firearms to prevent dinosaurs from reaching and destroying the egg.

items.question: Where can I find working Build a Dino Defense codes?
items.answer: All active Build a Dino Defense codes and redemption guides are monitored and updated on our wiki. As new codes are released by Big Chomp Games, they are verified and listed immediately.

items.question: What are the best turrets and traps in Build a Dino Defense?
items.answer: Laser Cannons and Cryo Slow Traps rank at the top of the tier list for late-game waves in Build a Dino Defense, while automated Sentry Turrets and Spike Traps offer the best early-game cost efficiency.

items.question: How do you survive dinosaur boss waves in Build a Dino Defense?
items.answer: To defeat boss dinosaurs in Build a Dino Defense, build layered choke-point walls, combine slow traps with heavy single-target laser fire, and coordinate with teammates using high-tier firearms from weapon crates.
